description: Two-handed weapon mastery - crushing single-target burst.

nodes.name: Improved Heroic Strike
nodes.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Heroic Strike by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 1/2/3 rage points.' Built verbatim. The outgoing version was 2 per rank, reaching 6 against the real 3.

nodes.name: Deflection
nodes.description: Increases your parry chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases your Parry chance by 5%' over 5 ranks. Built verbatim and kept from the outgoing tree. parry is PERCENTAGE POINTS, landing through a diminishing-returns curve so the realised value is slightly under nominal.

nodes.name: Improved Rend
nodes.description: Increases the bleed damage of your Rend by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases the bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 10%/20%.' Built verbatim over the real 2 ranks; the outgoing version had 3 ranks of 10%, reaching 30%.

nodes.name: Improved Charge
nodes.description: Charging generates 10 additional Rage.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, NEW to our tree: 'Increases the amount of rage generated by your Charge ability by 5/10.' DEPARTURE in mechanism only - a talent cannot modify an ability's own `generates` block, and rage_generation_pct is DEAD DATA (probed: zero read sites). Delivered as a grant_resource proc filtered to Charge, which puts the same rage in the same place. The chance carries the rank curve to 100% because a proc's payload does not scale with points.

nodes.name: Improved Overpower
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower by 25% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%/50%.' Built verbatim. The outgoing version reduced Overpower's COOLDOWN instead, which is Unrelenting Assault's job in the real tree.

nodes.name: Iron Will
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of Stun effects used against you by 7% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Reduces the duration of all Stun and Charm effects used against you by 20%' over 3 ranks. Charm does not exist; is_stun is this engine's only incapacitate. stun_duration_reduction_pct is a FRACTION, not points - audit_talents caught it being authored as 30.0 elsewhere in the project. Note it floors a stun at 1 turn, so it can shorten but never negate. Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 0.1 to 0.07 so three ranks reach 21%, the nearest whole percent per rank to the real 20%, rather than the 30% the outgoing value reached.

nodes.name: Anger Management
nodes.description: You generate 5 Rage every other turn.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Generates 1 rage per 3 seconds.' One rage per 3 seconds is one rage per turn; delivered as 5 every other turn, which is the same rate rounded into something noticeable. It has to be a proc because there is no passive-regeneration key for rage at all - rage_generation_pct is dead. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Tactical Mastery
nodes.description: Increases the threat generated by your Mortal Strike and Bloodthirst by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'You retain up to an additional 5/10/15 of your rage points when you change stances. Also greatly increases the threat generated by your Bloodthirst and Mortal Strike abilities when you are in Defensive Stance.' DEPARTURE - stance switching costs rage (stances.py STANCE_SWITCH_COST) but nothing modifies how much is retained, and threat has no per-ability key, only the global threat_generation_pct. So the threat half is built globally and unconditionally rather than gated to Defensive Stance - it could have been gated with require_form, but Arms is not a tanking tree and a stance gate on a tier-1 node would make it dead weight for the spec that takes it. The outgoing version was a cost cut on Mortal Strike.

nodes.name: Impale
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your abilities by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 10%/20%.' Built verbatim. crit_damage_physical is a FRACTION, read at abilities.py:1460 inside a ternary - the probe reports no literal read site, which is a probe limitation and not evidence of death. The outgoing version was 4 points of crit CHANCE on two abilities, a different stat entirely.

nodes.name: Deep Wounds
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 33% chance per rank to cause a bleed, dealing damage over 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Requires Melee Weapon. Your critical strikes cause the opponent to bleed, dealting 16%/32%/48% of your melee weapon's average damage over 6 sec.' Built as the real mechanic. Weapon-damage scaling is not available to a proc payload - potency is a flat per-turn number - so 40 per turn over 3 turns is a fixed bleed instead. NOTE a proc-applied dot states PER-TURN damage as `potency`, where an ABILITY rank's effect_value is the TOTAL and gets divided; getting that backwards is a 3x error in either direction. 6 seconds is 3 turns, the standard bucket. The real talent requires Impale, which connected_to reproduces.

nodes.name: Poleaxe Specialization
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Requires One-Handed Axes, Polearms, Two-Handed Axes. Increases your chance to get a critical strike and the critical damage caused with Axes and Polearms by 5%.' DEPARTURE - no weapon-type key, so the gate is dropped. Only the crit CHANCE half is kept; adding the crit-damage half too would double up on Impale two rows above. The outgoing version was flat attack_power_pct.

nodes.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
nodes.description: Increases your physical damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree: 'Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 2%/4%/6%.' Built verbatim minus the weapon gate. physical_damage is a FRACTION with four real read sites.

nodes.name: Sweeping Strikes
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Whirlwind and Cleave by 20%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.' DEPARTURE - nothing in this engine modifies how many targets an ability hits. max_targets caps an existing AoE rather than widening a single-target hit, and there is no attack-counter to spend down. Delivered as damage on the two abilities that ALREADY hit multiple targets, which is the nearest honest reading. Kept from the outgoing tree, which reached the same conclusion. The real talent is Mortal Strike's prerequisite, preserved below.

nodes.name: Taste for Blood
nodes.description: Your Rend has a 33% chance per rank to reset the cooldown of your Overpower.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree: 'Whenever your Rend ability causes damage, you have a 33%/66%/100% chance of allowing the use of your Overpower ability for 9 sec.' Built as the real mechanic - reset_cooldown is a real proc payload (status_effects.py:1207) and knocking Overpower's cooldown off IS 'allowing the use of' it. The real chance curve is exact. The 9-second window and the 1-charge clause are not expressible - no charge system - so the reset is immediate and unconditional instead.

nodes.name: Mace Specialization
nodes.description: Your attacks ignore 3% of your target's armor per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree: 'Your attacks with maces ignore up to 15% of your opponent's armor.' The real 15% over 5 ranks, minus the weapon gate. armor_penetration_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS - it lands on the attribute divided by 100, so 3.0 is 3%, and it is read by monster.py:658 via getattr on the ATTACKER rather than through get_talent_effect.

nodes.name: Sword Specialization
nodes.description: Your swings have a 2% chance per rank to grant an extra attack.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree: 'Requires One-Handed Swords, Two-Handed Swords. Gives you a 10% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after hitting your target with your Sword.' extra_attack is a BOOLEAN - exactly one extra attack, no count - which is precisely what the real talent grants. 2% per rank reaches the real 10% at 5 ranks. Weapon gate dropped.

nodes.name: Weapon Mastery
nodes.description: Increases your expertise by 2 per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Reduces the chance for your attacks to be dodged by 1%/2% and reduces the duration of all Disarm effects used against you by 25%/50%.' Reducing the chance to be dodged IS expertise, so that half is exact. Disarm duration is not modifiable. The outgoing version granted hit_rating - which, before creature avoidance was added for humanoids and bosses, was genuinely indistinguishable from expertise; Kyle's own note was 'expertise is basically hit rating unless we can encode parry and dodge in enemies'. Now that they are encoded, this node is meaningfully different.

nodes.name: Trauma
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Rend by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Your melee critical strikes increase the effectiveness of Bleed effects on the target by 15%/30% for 1 min.' DEPARTURE - nothing can modify an EXISTING effect's potency from outside it, and bleed_dot_damage is dead data. Delivered as direct Rend damage, which is the bleed this tree actually applies. Kept from the outgoing tree at the real 15% per rank.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.description: Being struck has a 50% chance per rank to generate 20 Rage.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Whenever you are struck by a Stun or Immobilize effect you will generate 10/20 rage and 5%/10% of your total health over 10 sec.' DEPARTURE on the trigger - nothing fires when the actor BECOMES stunned, and there is no immobilise. on_damage_taken is the nearest real moment. The real 20 rage is kept; the heal-over-time half is dropped rather than doubling the node's value. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Mortal Strike
nodes.description: Teaches Mortal Strike, a vicious wound that weakens healing on the target.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, kept - the ONLY unlock for warrior_mortal_strike, which is requires_talent, so dropping it would strand the ability. The real talent requires Sweeping Strikes, which connected_to reproduces.

nodes.name: Improved Mortal Strike
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Mortal Strike by 3% per rank and reduces its cooldown by 1 turn.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'Increases the damage caused by your Mortal Strike ability by 3%/6%/10% and reduces the cooldown by 1 sec.' Both halves built. The cooldown key is FLAT turns and authored at 1 PER RANK, which over 3 ranks takes Mortal Strike's 3-turn cooldown to its 1-turn floor - talented_cooldown clamps at 1, so this cannot reach zero. The real talent requires Mortal Strike, reproduced.

nodes.name: Strength of Arms
nodes.description: Increases your Strength and Stamina by 2% per rank and your expertise by 2 per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'Increases your total Strength and Stamina by 2%/4% and your Expertise by 2/4.' Built verbatim, all three halves. strength_pct and stamina_pct are PERCENTAGE POINTS, read at character.py:1262-1263 off the `bonuses` dict and divided by 100 - the probe finds no literal read site because that line does not call get_talent_effect, so they LOOK dead and are not.

nodes.name: Unrelenting Assault
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Overpower by 1 turn per rank and increases its damage by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'Reduces the cooldown of your Overpower and Revenge abilities by 2/4 secs and increases the damage done by both abilities by 10%/20%.' Revenge does not exist here, so only the Overpower half is built - with both of its clauses at the real numbers.

nodes.name: Sudden Death
nodes.description: Your strikes have a 3% chance per rank to let you Execute regardless of the target's health.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Your melee hits have a 3%/6%/9% chance of allowing the use of Execute regardless of the target's health state. In addition, you keep at least 10 rage after using Execute.' Built with the real mechanic and the real chance curve: bypass_execute_threshold is a real proc FLAG, CONSUMED ON USE, and execute_threshold_pct is enforced at abilities.py:1741. The rage-retention half is dropped. NOTE the nested proc inside apply_effect works but is NOT inspected by audit_talents, so this one is verified by spending it on a live warrior rather than by the audit.

nodes.name: Endless Rage
nodes.description: You generate 5 additional Rage whenever you strike.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'You generate 25% more rage from damage dealt.' DEPARTURE - rage_generation_pct is DEAD DATA (probed, zero read sites, already recorded as dead in the project), so a percentage increase to rage generation cannot be expressed at all. Delivered as flat rage on a strike, icd 1 so it is once a turn. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Wrecking Crew
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 20% chance per rank to enrage you, increasing all your damage by 10% for 4 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Your melee critical hits Enrage you, increasing all damage caused by 2%-10% for 12 sec.' Built with the real 10% at full rank and the real 12 seconds (4 turns). Ranked by CHANCE rather than magnitude because a proc's chance scales with points_spent and its payload does not - 2%-to-10% at a fixed chance is not authorable. The 'does not stack with Enrage' clause is handled by exclusive_group in Fury, where Enrage lives. The outgoing version was a 1-point proc.

nodes.name: Blood Frenzy
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Increases your melee attack speed by 5%/10%. In addition your Rend and Deep Wounds abilities also increase all physical damage caused to that target by 2%/4%.' The haste half is built verbatim at the real 10%. The target-debuff half needs a bleed-presence read on the target, which does not exist. haste is PERCENTAGE POINTS. The outgoing version was Rend damage, which is Trauma's job.

nodes.name: Bladestorm
nodes.description: Teaches Bladestorm, whirling through every nearby enemy.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone, kept - the ONLY unlock for warrior_bladestorm, which is requires_talent. The real talent's repeated whirlwind over 6 seconds is the ability's own business; there are no channelled or repeating effects for a talent to express.
